projectDescription: An offline-first visual compiler for designing, validating, and compiling deterministic agent workflows into self-contained artifacts for Codex, Claude, Hermes Agent, Python, or TypeScript.
keyFeatures: Visual drag-and-drop canvas and synchronized LGIR YAML editor
Eleven canonical node kinds: input, output, agent, tool, transform, condition, evaluate, approval, join, loop, group, subgraph
Structured bounded loops with maxIterations and exhaustion policies
Sequential and parallel execution groups with aggregate or serialize exits
Safe declarative transforms: select, rename, merge, filter, deduplicate, sort, slice
Visual macros for Parallel, Pipeline, Reduce, and Verify topologies
Deterministic compilation to Codex, Claude, Hermes Agent, Python, and TypeScript targets
DAG validation, diagnostics with stable codes, severity levels, and safe repair suggestions
Target-aware capability catalog for skills, tools, connectors, and permissions
16 outcome-led starter templates and 68 editable role templates
IndexedDB and OPFS offline-first persistence, revision history, import/export, and PWA support
Rust/WebAssembly compiler core with TypeScript parity fallback
No accounts, no telemetry, no model or runtime connections
publicApiSurface: LGIR YAML schema: apiVersion ladder.dev/v1alpha1, kind Workflow
Diagnostic: code, severity, path, nodeId, edgeId, message, capability, fix
CompileResult: content, suggestedFilename, mimeType, sourceHash, compilerVersion, adapterVersion, capabilityReport, diagnostics
ProjectRecord: id, name, yaml, lastValidYaml, target, createdAt, updatedAt
